text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, before the autumn Tenno Sho, Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet have a talk at the planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet has continued to walk on her path, carefully connecting the lines in her predetermined constellation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Vodka unconventionally focuses on the individual stars, unbothered by the big picture.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks fly between their two opposing constellations as they look towards the big race.
